issues.location: first part of the satisfaction-entailment proof
issues.finding: The first claim assumes Gamma is true at w, but its proof starts by assuming Gamma true throughout M. That stronger assumption proves only a special case and the intervening all-worlds step is unnecessary.
issues.proposed_resolution: Start from satisfaction of Gamma at w and apply the definition of entailment directly to obtain satisfaction of A at w.

translation_treatment: Translated local and model-wide truth, validity, entailment, generated restriction and its two applications. Corrected the first proof's hypothesis and removed the unnecessary global-satisfaction step. Localized the equation's ordinary prose and to lan.
